verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm offering legal advisory services. Its document-automation tools (SCC and Term Sheet generators built on Contract Express, Docusign integration, Legora/Luminance collaborations) are client-facing questionnaires, not developer platforms. Official SDKs are a category error for this kind of professional-services firm, and no evidence shows it ships any SDK or API (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
